outputs: logit of the teachers' average P(we win)
softplus gives the SD of P(we win) across the teachers
logit of the behaviour chain's P(we win)
positions: network k values the lobby after k bans

plan.note: counts_ok[position][band][hero]: real teams made this ban at this position in this band at least min_count times (training + validation); fallback: with no supported ban, the ban a typical team is likeliest to make

ban_order: one block of heroes per ban position (position i at ban_order + i * heroes), one-hot for the bans made so far
rule: our turn: score every legal ban not shown by us with the next position's student; choose the highest mean - kappa x SD + plan.lam x log p among supported bans, p the ban's probability under the ban model as the page sees the lobby (the exported stand-in tables); supported: p >= support and counts_ok at this position and band; with no supported ban, the likeliest ban (v8.6, review 2; before it: all legal bans, and no lam or count rule)
spread: the SD output is the conditional ensemble spread: the teachers' disagreement given one fitted world, not an interval for real games

registration.features: from the registered players' compact records (profiles_v9): [0, H) their hero shares summed; [H, 2H) their taste vectors summed (factors @ taste_W'); [2H, 3H) their per-hero skill summed; [3H, 3H + 3) their forced role-stay rate added at their main role (tank, damage, support; none: nothing); 3H + 3: the mean over registered slots of (the player's rank - the lobby's rank) / 100 (the page uses the rank entered for the slot, else 0); 3H + 4: the number of registered slots / 6. All zero with no registered slot
registration.page_view: our team j for the ban model = the tail prior after k known slots (k = registered slots + shown heroes in unregistered slots, at most 6) + the shown unregistered heroes' profiles + the registered players' shares and squared shares (2H channels) from their records
registration.outside_pool: a registered id missing from profiles_v9 (fewer than MINHIST starts or no Season 10 rank by the end of validation) is treated as anonymous: the page says so and that slot keeps the band prior
registration.simulated: REG_K ~ uniform 0..1 registered slots per lobby (slot 0 first); each registered player's premade partners (in the pool) joined with probability 0

check.note: the page's policy with the lobby's registered slots visible minus the same policy with the registration dropped; 2 = two or more registered slots

evidence.note: identified: at least identified_min real bans of the hero at that position and rank band in REAL_Q's training span; thin: at least thin_min; none: fewer. The page shows the flag next to the simulator's gain; flagged bans are shown, not hidden (the page's rule is unchanged). slopes: RQH (points per unit of reliance; SE in logit units x 25), target from the other team's bans, own from the team's own bans (confounded)
